goals: Verify that the application's language can be changed to French and the UI updates accordingly.
Verify that clicking the 'Get Started' button redirects the user to Spotify's authorization page with the correct PKCE parameters.
Verify that the application successfully exchanges the authorization code for an access token using PKCE and updates the UI.
Verify that the application renders the post-login UI when an access token is present in local storage.
Verify that clicking the 'Change user' button triggers the logout process with the correct parameters.
activities: Render the App component.
Find the 'Get Started' link element.
Assert that the 'Get Started' link element has the text content 'Get Started'.
Find the 'Change language' button.
Click the 'Change language' button.
Find the 'Français' language option element.
Assert that the 'Français' language option element is present in the document.
Click the 'Français' language option.
Assert that the 'Commencer' text is present in the document.
Assert that the 'Get Started' link element now has the text content 'Commencer'.
Render the App component.
Find the 'Get Started' link element.
Assert that the 'Get Started' link element is present in the document.
Click the 'Get Started' link element.
Assert that the window location href matches the Spotify authorization URL pattern.
Assert that the window location href contains 'response_type=code'.
Assert that the window location href contains the correct client ID.
Assert that the window location href contains the 'playlist-read-private' scope.
Assert that the window location href contains 'code_challenge_method=S256'.
Assert that the window location href contains a code challenge.
Assert that the window location href contains 'show_dialog=false'.
Render the App component.
Wait for the access token to be stored in local storage.
Assert that the token request body is not null.
Assert that the token request body contains the correct client ID.
Assert that the token request body contains 'grant_type=authorization_code'.
Assert that the token request body contains the 'TEST_AUTH_CODE'.
Assert that the token request body contains the 'TEST_CODE_VERIFIER'.
Assert that the token request body contains the correct redirect URI.
Assert that `history.replaceState` was called to update the URL.
Assert that the playlist table spinner is present in the document.
Render the App component.
Assert that the playlist table spinner is present in the document.
Render the App component.
Find the 'Change user' element.
Assert that the 'Change user' element is present in the document.
Click the 'Change user' element.
Assert that the `logout` function was called with 'true'.
